[INJSO 2019 — question paper]
9. A researcher centrifuged human blood at low speed to separate the red blood cells
(RBCs) and white blood cells (WBCs). She then suspended the pellet of RBCs in saline
(0.9% NaCl). She subsequently put a drop of the RBC suspension into three different
solutions as indicated below. What will be her observations for solutions I, II and III
respectively?
Solution I Solution II Solution III
Detergent Distilled 5% NaCl
water
(A)Lysis, lysis, swelling.
(B) Swelling, no change, shrinkage.
(C) Lysis, lysis, shrinkage.
(D)No change, shrinkage, swelling.
